subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this issue remain the broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident tracker, or should maintainers split it across the existing replay, reply-init, WebChat, and session-isolation trackers now?
rationale: The source and related items show several real adjacent fixes, but no landed item proves the full WebChat plus WhatsApp one-exchange-then-silence and duplicate-reply state is resolved; choosing the canonical tracking shape needs maintainer incident triage.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the stable package, WebChat reply path, WhatsApp replay path, and stuck-session recovery are correlated against the same symptom set.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move the remaining evidence to the existing replay, reply-init, WebChat, and session-isolation items, then close only after each slice has an owner and proof target.

options.title: Close Under Package Parity
options.body: Close only if maintainers confirm the reply-session package-parity conflict fully explains the all-channel silence and duplicate-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the stable package, WebChat reply path, WhatsApp replay path, and stuck-session recovery are correlated against the same symptom set.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue crosses release/package parity and the current gateway/session/channel source state where this person has the strongest available history signal in the checked-out evidence.
